status: Complete local qualification:29 native,27 component/typed-client,18 SDK/portable and242 rendered controls pass. No current type-copy change is published.
decisions: Prefer immutable per-task lineage on the new CompanionTask over a new document entity collection. The existing Workspace transfer merge already preserves nested task fields; a new document collection would otherwise be omitted from mapped state. Original source archives stay retained.

Add an optional null-omitted CopyLineage property to CompanionTask. Proposed lineage fields: original SourceWorkspaceId, shallow full SourceSnapshot with CopyLineage cleared, TargetTaskId, TargetKind, CopyOrganization, explicit initial Daily recurrence, InitialTargetRevision, CommandId, PayloadHash and CopiedAtUtc. The shallow source snapshot avoids recursively growing copy-of-copy archives; the actual source task and original lineage stay unchanged.

Validate native lineage against the original source/current workspace, or the exact SourceImports source workspace and imported target record identity after transfer. Keep original source revisions and nested snapshots unchanged when outer task revisions shift. The target kind must stay immutable. Validate original command/hash/initial task fields against the accepted entry when the original entry exists; imported original receipts remain in immutable original archives.

Use a new CopyTaskType operation and patch.TypeCopy selector with exact source ID/revision, selected different target kind, explicit CopyOrganization boolean and explicit Daily recurrence. Command.TaskId names a newly allocated target. Add a length-prefixed hash extension over legacy command identity; preserve all old absent/default fields and hashes.

Handle the new native command in a separate acceptance branch after common identity, duplicate, authority and revision guards. Original source stays unchanged. Create one active unlinked target, append one immutable command/accepted event/creation activity witness and never enqueue projection/tag work. Native scope must forbid ProjectToHabitica, score, count or occurrence extras.

Do not globally redefine ordinary isTaskCreation to force game correspondence. Server preparation and typed/UI ID allocation need an explicit new-target predicate for CopyTaskType. Activity witness creation provenance must recognize the new operation, while ordinary creation/projection policy stays unchanged.

Generic prepare_task_command, a new copy_task_type acceptance tool and get_task_command should share stable request/server target/command identity and original receipt recovery. New preview/receipt metadata must show complete copied/reset fields, original source and exact native target. Caller target IDs are forbidden during cloud preparation.

The conversion flow retains the source. Optional archival remains a separate existing reviewed action; the new copy UI offers no combined archive or new archival authority. No original kind/history/mapping is rewritten or transferred.

Copy exact title/notes/native urgency and optionally all valid current category/project/section/labels. Archived/removed/mismatched organization requires an explicit empty-organization choice or repair. Reset state to active, dates/reviews, game metadata/directions, stage, relationships/goals and event history. Daily recurrence is a new explicit native IANA-capable choice, independent of provider fixed-zone projection limits.

Add a scoped panel to the existing /todo/conversions route alongside the current checklist-to-project conversion panel. Preserve the existing checklist conversion protocol. Include exact active/historical/archived source selection, twenty-row paging, explicit target kind, Daily rule fields, organization choice, complete before/after/reset review, unknown original receipt recovery and private account/source fencing. Agent parity uses MCP; browser automation is synthetic qualification only.

The implemented lineage record uses SourceWorkspaceId, shallow SourceSnapshot, TargetTaskId/TargetKind, CopyOrganization, InitialTargetRevision, CommandId/PayloadHash, CopiedAtUtc and optional initial Daily recurrence. Current native source existence/kind/revision or exact SourceImports provenance validates the reference. Source snapshot must have CopyLineage=null.

The per-task property now exists on CompanionTask and WorkspaceRules checks lineage. C# export and revision-offset import examples pass; TypeScript workspaceTask/journal known keys and lineage parser still need implementation before actual portable imports are supported.

Retain optional lineage in later task snapshots unchanged. Add a semantic lineage equality check across initial/current/accepted snapshots, normalizing nullable empty lists/metadata where legacy wire normalization requires equivalence. Initial conversion entries must bind exact original command/hash, native target fields and zero projection/tag effects. Later normal task edits retain the lineage.

Existing transfer merge maps nested task fields and retains original byte archives; the new per-task lineage avoids a new dropped document collection. Original nested source revisions stay unchanged while outer task revisions shift. SourceImports provenance qualifies imported original workspace references.

Native source metadata can legitimately evolve under later root changes. Compare immutable current target lineage against the original accepted target snapshot, rather than assuming every original source field must match a later current source with the same sparse task revision. The immutability Red and Green cover a forged earlier source snapshot after a later source edit.

Snapshot recurrence validity is structural for portable storage. New native Daily acceptance additionally requires actual timezone/calendar availability; an unavailable historical timezone stays readable and cannot authorize a new copy.

A nullable type_copy_preview_json column on workspace_preparations durably stores the original copied/reset-field review without putting decorative before/after data into semantic command identity. Migration0023 and the synthetic migration fixture list are added. Preview metadata counts against archive bytes and has a256KiB bound.

Task copy reveals complete private before fields; MCP copy_task_type and prepare_task_command when operation=copyTaskType require both tasks:read and habitica.tasks.write. taskRequiredScopes centralizes conditional service enforcement and advertised copy-tool scopes; browser owner sessions keep existing account authorization.

CopyTaskType skips preview/tag authority and tag reconciliation, allocates a new target during cloud preparation, and exposes stored typeCopyPreview plus the original copyLineage only for copy receipts. Ordinary task receipts remain unchanged. Native schema/storage and initial TypeScript integration are not final acceptance.

The pure model covers all six different Todo/Daily/Habit pairs, historical/linked originals, same-kind/stale/missing Daily rule refusal, exact copied/reset fields and archived organization repair. Full atomic/journal/wire/receipt/MCP/UI/export-import qualification remains required.
